RDHUB Analytics

2026-10-16

Overview

This report is generated automatically by the daily Ebola Analytics Pipeline. It shares its data, parameters, prediction zones, and coefficients with the interactive portal.

Workflow: prepare data -> wrangle -> compute primary parameters -> train the SIR model -> test on a holdout -> assess performance -> project the next 14 days.

Population at risk: 20,000,000 persons.

STEP 3 — Primary Parameters

Primary parameters derived from raw data
Parameter Value
Population at risk (N) 2e+07
Initial susceptible (S0) 19,999,746
Initial infectious (I0) 173
Growth rate (r) 0.0050 /day
Recovery rate (gamma) 0.1000 /day
Mortality rate (mu) 0.0475 /day
Transmission rate (beta) 0.1525 /day
Basic reproduction number (R0) 1.034

Key calculations

  • Growth rate (r): log-linear regression on the first 30 percent of the daily incidence series.
  • Recovery rate (gamma): gamma = 1 / 10 days.
  • Mortality rate (mu): mu = (CFR / 100) / infectious period.
  • Transmission rate (beta): beta = r + gamma + mu.
  • Reproduction number (R0): R0 = beta / (gamma + mu).
